Source: https://github.com/AImenes/sudokUI

The engine and English technique documentation are preserved from upstream.
Local override in engine/ratings.ts: Almost Locked Sets, Miscellaneous and
Complex Fish are temporarily disabled in solver/rating/practice orders. The
catalogue keeps these entries visible and explicitly labels them disabled.
All 80 catalogue entries are presented on the Techniques page, with upstream
implementation status. Classic technique implementations are retained as source,
not used to make deductions on irregular regions. The irregular solver is a new
region-aware backtracking solver; the reference guide does not claim all classic
patterns transfer to irregular Sudoku. Upstream text is unmodified.
